source_row.stem: A client with a wound infection caused by a multidrug-resistant organism with significant drainage requires:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Airborne precautions alone, without the contact precautions more relevant to a draining wound infection","B":"A combination of precautions (such as contact precautions) tailored to the specific transmission risks","C":"No specific precautions beyond what would be used for any client without a known infection","D":"Standard precautions alone, without the additional transmission-based precautions this situation calls for"}}
source_row.rationale: Some clients require a combination of precaution types tailored to the specific transmission risks present, such as contact precautions for a draining wound with a multidrug-resistant organism, determined by the specific pathogen and clinical situation.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Combined and Pathogen-Specific Isolation Precautions
